What is the sponsor equity cheque, in millions of dollars?

follow_up.question: Why do transaction fees increase the sponsor equity requirement here?
follow_up.reference: Fees are an additional cash use at closing. With the debt amount fixed and no other funding source, sponsor equity must cover them.
